accounts.deleteContent: The widget will stop reading this config directory. It can be added again later.
accounts.empty: No accounts yet. Add a config directory before the widget can read this provider.
accounts.needEnabled: Turn on an account before choosing which one the widget shows by default.
accounts.name: Account name
accounts.credentialsHint: Leave empty to use the default credentials file in the config directory.

app.refreshDisconnected: The widget is not connected, so it cannot refresh
app.savedCacheFailed: Settings were saved, but the usage cache could not be read
app.refreshSent: Asked the widget to refresh usage
app.accountIdFailed: Could not assign an account id

diagnostics.title: Diagnostics
diagnostics.description: The log shows why a read did not update.
diagnostics.emptyOffDescription: Turn logging on, reproduce the issue, then reload.

general.title: General
general.description: Refresh interval, startup, and the language used by the settings window and the widget.
general.refreshDescription: How often usage is read, and whether the app starts with Windows.
general.pollIntervalDescription: Default is {{defaultMinutes}} minutes. Set a value from 1 to {{maxMinutes}}.
general.startupDescription: Start the tray and widget after signing in to Windows.
general.languageDescription: The settings window and the widget use this language.

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Check whether the widget is connected, and whether enabled providers have a reading.
overview.disconnectedDescription: Settings can still be saved. Refresh needs the widget process. Open it from the tray.
overview.emptyDescription: On the Providers page, turn on the items that should appear on the widget.

providers.title: Providers
providers.description: When off, the widget hides that provider. An empty config directory uses the local default.
providers.multiDescription: Claude Code and Codex can each use more than one config directory.
providers.singleDescription: Each provider uses the one account already signed in on this computer.
providers.aihubmixTokenDescription: Generate it on the AIHubMix settings page. It is not a model API key. One dollar is 500000 quota.
providers.aihubmixUsageLimitDescription: The widget shows whole dollars over this limit, for example $23/$100. The tooltip keeps cents, for example $23.47/$100. Leave it empty and the widget shows the whole-dollar balance; the tooltip still shows the balance with cents.

items.claude: Read Anthropic usage and show it on the widget.
items.codex: Read OpenAI usage and show it on the widget.
items.antigravity: Read Google usage and show it on the widget.
items.opencode: Read OpenCode Go usage and show it on the widget.
items.cursor: Read Cursor usage and show it on the widget.
items.grok: Read xAI usage and show it on the widget.
items.copilot: Read GitHub usage and show it on the widget.
items.grok_bot: Read usage from the Grok Bot desktop app and show it on the widget.
items.aihubmix: Read the AIHubMix account balance and show the remaining dollars on the widget.

usage.authRejected: Sign-in was rejected. Sign in again.
usage.noCredentials: No credentials found. Check the config directory, or set the credentials file.
usage.tokenExpired: Sign-in has expired. Sign in again.
usage.requestFailed: This request did not succeed. The next refresh will retry.
usage.networkError: The network is unavailable. The next refresh will retry.
usage.unexpectedResponse: The response could not be parsed. The next refresh will retry.
usage.httpStatus: The request returned {{code}}. The next refresh will retry.
usage.readFailed: The read failed. The next refresh will retry.

widget.title: Widget
widget.description: These values apply to the widget immediately.
widget.displayDescription: Numbers on the widget and how it docks.
widget.directionDescription: Used shows consumption. Remaining shows what is left. The widget uses the same direction.
widget.lockTaskbarDescription: Keep the widget in the taskbar instead of floating out.
widget.trayIconsDescription: Show each provider's usage icon in the notification area.
widget.avatarDescription: Show the provider avatar next to the usage.
widget.resetDescription: Show the time remaining after the percentage, for example 29 days.
widget.gapDescription: Only the distance between neighboring providers.
widget.orderDescription: Left to right. Fable stays after Claude Code.
